title: Renewable Treasures
description: Adds ways to make treasures like Enchanted Golden Apples renewable!
body:
# Renewable Treasures
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
This datapack adds various ways to renew treasure items, Music Discs, and Pottery Sherds that are normally non-renewable!

This is designed to work with my [Better Non-Renewables Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/uglZSVKi)!
## Affected Blocks/Items
- Wind Burst Enchanted Books
- Swift Sneak Enchanted Books
- Heart of the Sea
- Enchanted Golden Apples
- Flow, Guster, and Snout Banner Patterns
- Heavy Core
- Sponges
- Suspicious Sand and Gravel
- All Pottery Sherds
- Disc Fragments
- Echo Shards
- Non-renewable Music Discs
  - Pigstep
  - otherside
  - 5
  - Relic
  - Creator
  - Creator (Music Box)
  - Precipice
  - Bounce
## Recipes Added
Recipes are shown in the Gallery. I tried to make each recipe require you _already_ obtaining the item you wish to renew. So no crafting Enchanted Golden Apples out of thin air, you have to find one first.

For items that don't stack (like the Banner Patterns), I chose the closest equivalent for them I could, and their recipe is only unlocked once the original item has been found.
## Loot Tables Altered
> **Suspicious Sand & Gravel** can be picked up with a Silk Touch tool.

> **Breezes** have a 2.5% chance to drop a Wind Burst I-II Enchanted Book. Can be increased up to 5.5% with Looting III.

> **Wardens** have a 100% chance to drop a Swift Sneak I-III Enchanted Book.

> **Fishing** has a 0.4% chance to drop a Heart of the Sea. Can be increased up to 0.9% with Luck of the Sea III.

> **Creepers** now drop
> - **Preicipe**, **Creator**, or **Creator (Music Box) Discs** when killed by a **Breeze**
> - **Bounce Music Disc** when blown up by a **TNT Sulfur Cube**
> - **Pigstep Music Disc** when killed by a **Piglin**
> - **Creepers** now drop the **otherside Music Disc** when killed by a **Warden**

> **Sniffers** now have a 0.5% chance to dig up the **Relic Music Disc**.
## IMPORTANT
> **Suspicious Sand and Gravel** will not generate items when brushing after they have been placed. Only naturally generated Suspicious Sand and Gravel will drop items when brushed.

> **Pottery Sherds** are unable to be transformed into one another, only "duplicated" via crafting. All **Pottery Sherd** recipes are unlocked after collecting any **Pottery Sherd**.
## More
I haven't figured out a good way to make modular datapacks, so don't be afraid to go into the file and delete any .json files in the [loot_table] or [recipe] folders you don't want!

Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
